title: Mermail Inbox Canary — real diagnostic run (X cut, under 140 s)
note: Concise cut for a native X upload (120–140 s). Uses the same scenes as narration.json minus poll/checks/report, with the same sentence count per scene so the visual cues stay in sync. Facts must match src/evidence.json.

sentences.say: An agent needs one answer before it shares its email address.
sentences.show: An agent needs one answer before it shares its email address.

sentences.say: Does this mailbox actually deliver mail, end to end?
sentences.show: Does this mailbox actually deliver mail, end to end?

sentences.say: The Mer mail Inbox Canary skill answers with one tagged probe.
sentences.show: The Mermail Inbox Canary skill answers with one tagged probe.

sentences.say: Here is a real run, where the round trip could not be verified.
sentences.show: Here is a real run — where the round trip could not be verified.

sentences.say: The request:
sentences.show: The request:

sentences.say: Use Mer mail to prove my agent mailbox can send and receive mail, before I hand the address to a service.
sentences.show: “Use Mermail to prove my agent mailbox can send and receive mail before I hand the address to a service.”

sentences.say: The captured log shows a real Mer mail M C P session.
sentences.show: The captured runner log shows a real hosted Mermail MCP session.

sentences.say: Server version one point oh point oh, with ninety-four tools.
sentences.show: server mermail 1.0.0 · protocol 2025-06-18 · catalog: 94 tools

sentences.say: Send email is present, which the probe needs.
sentences.show: send_email is present, which the probe needs.

sentences.say: List mailboxes selected one owner inbox: token junkie labs, at Mer mail dot app.
sentences.show: list_workspaces + list_mailboxes selected tokenjunkielabs@mermail.app (public_id e48c62aa…).

sentences.say: The probe plan is journaled first.
sentences.show: The probe plan is journaled first.

sentences.say: Planned for ten fifty-one, U T C.
sentences.show: planned_send_at 2026-10-07T10:51:25.521Z · token mc-20261007-fq450to1

sentences.say: Then exactly one send email call, approved by the operator.
sentences.show: Then exactly one send_email call — approved via --approve-send by the operator.

sentences.say: The receipt came back with status queued.
sentences.show: Receipt: id d1658608… · status queued · undo_until 10:51:38.363Z.

sentences.say: This video is a replay of that run. No new email was sent.
sentences.show: This video replays that run. No new email was sent.

sentences.say: Next, the runner searched for the token. With a self probe, that can match two messages: the sent copy, and, if delivery works, the received copy.
sentences.show: Next, the runner searched for the token. In a self-probe that can match two messages: the sent copy and, if delivery works, the received copy.

sentences.say: So a match is only a candidate.
sentences.show: So a match is only a candidate.

sentences.say: Each recorded read returned one message: the send receipt's own identifier, in the Sent folder.
sentences.show: Every recorded read returned one message: d1658608… — the send receipt’s own id, folder_id "sent".

sentences.say: Later reads show it delivered, still in Sent, total count one.
sentences.show: Reads at 10:52:50Z and 10:55:23Z: delivery_status "delivered", folder Sent, totalCount 1.

sentences.say: That proves the outgoing leg only.
sentences.show: That proves the outgoing leg only.

sentences.say: No distinct incoming copy was observed.
sentences.show: No distinct incoming copy was observed.

sentences.say: The runner's own verdict got this wrong.
sentences.show: The runner’s own verdict got this wrong.

sentences.say: Its log called the Sent row, the arrived probe.
sentences.show: Its log called the Sent row “the arrived probe” — folder_id "sent", delivery_status "queued".

sentences.say: It reported a six point five second round trip, from a record date, not a receipt.
sentences.show: It reported “degraded — round-trip 6.5s” from the date field: a record date, not a receipt.

sentences.say: That result is withdrawn.
sentences.show: That result is withdrawn — never inbox proof.

sentences.say: The matcher now rejects the sent copy, and requires an in bound marker.
sentences.show: The matcher now rejects the send receipt’s own id, Sent/Outbox and queued, and requires an inbound marker.

sentences.say: That fix was only tested on a synthetic case.
sentences.show: That fix was only tested on a synthetic case — not provider evidence.

sentences.say: The authoritative record: outgoing, delivered. Incoming, not observed. Round trip latency: not available.
sentences.show: Authoritative: OUTBOUND DELIVERED · INBOUND NOT OBSERVED · ROUND-TRIP LATENCY UNAVAILABLE.

sentences.say: The inbound message identifier is null, and the latency is null.
sentences.show: inbound_message_id: null · round_trip_latency: null

sentences.say: Not healthy, and not reported as healthy.
sentences.show: Not healthy — and not reported as healthy.

sentences.say: The skill's rule, which that verdict broke: never claim arrival on the basis of a send success.
sentences.show: The skill’s rule — which that verdict broke: “Never claim the probe arrived on the basis of a send success or a pending state.”
